title: Beasts of the deep
summary: Five new creatures from Greek myth join the monster signals, each cut from your reference art into a living rig: Cetus, the sea monster that swims where it heads and breaches out of the void; Echidna, the mother of monsters, with her brood of serpents and pools of venom; the Hydra, whose cut heads grow back as double heads circling it; the Chimera, three heads each fighting its own way; and Charybdis, a whirlpool that drags you toward its maw. Every creature now fights in its own bullet patterns and styles, changing as the fight goes on - and running away doesn't save you: creatures chase you at your speed, follow you out of their signal into the system, and fire faster at a fleeing ship. Shields are spheres that cover every sprite. Signals now have levels - easy, moderate, hard, insane - scaling their enemies and rewards, and cargo holds are roomy enough for any encounter's loot.

steps.title: Sphere shields that cover everything
steps.text: Shields were ellipses fitted to each sprite, and on long ships and big creatures they left parts uncovered. Now every shield is a sphere whose diameter is the sprite's diagonal plus 24 px, so it always covers the whole picture - your ship (resized when you change ships), every NPC ship and every creature. The shader lights it like a ball: a soft highlight up-left, a rim of light opposite. On creatures it sits behind the art at 28 % strength, so the painting stays readable.

steps.title: Every creature its own bullets
steps.text: Each creature now fights in its own bullet patterns, from a pool that changes as the fight goes on: denser and faster after 40 s or below 2/3 of its hull, and again after 80 s or below 1/3. Ten new bullet styles give each one a look: Skylla's foam-crested sea waves (replacing her tentacle sweep), Cerberus' fireballs, embers and the wailing souls of Hades that drift after you, the Minotaur's spears, and for the new creatures serpents, venom, fangs and poison clouds. And running away no longer escapes them: fired at you as you flee, a creature's bullets fly faster - about three times at your full speed.

steps.title: Cetus, the sea monster
steps.text: Cetus, the monster Poseidon sent against Andromeda, is cut from your top view - body, both fins and the tail fin - and unlike the other creatures it turns to face where it swims. A shader bends its body in a wave running head to tail, and the fins and tail ride the same curve. It raises rings of breaking waves, jets bubbles from its maw and whirls arms of waves. Its special is the dive: it sinks, its shadow slides toward you under the void, a ring marks where you were - and it breaches there, your side-view art leaping out with a burst of waves.

steps.title: Echidna, the mother of monsters
steps.text: Echidna - half woman, half serpent - is cut from your top view into her body, both arms and the crescent of her tail; her arms reach and claw, her tail sways, her eyes burn gold as she gathers. Her art is cut by colour (an AI cut-out left her coils half transparent). She looses fangs of venom curving in from both sides, closes a ring of serpents around you (find the gap), and spins hissing spirals. Rearing up in your front view she looses her brood - serpents that slither after you - and she spits venom that leaves burning pools.

steps.title: The Hydra, and its double heads
steps.text: The Hydra is cut from your top view into the knot of its coils and eight heads - each weaving out of step and firing from its own jaws. The head nearest you bites, darting out on a stretched scaly neck; rearing up in the front view it breathes rings of poison. And as in the myth, cut off a head and two grow back: every twelfth of its hull you take, the nearest head is severed and a double head (your sprite) bursts from the stump. Double heads keep their place round the Hydra and fire from both jaws - up to 12 at once - but they can't be targeted or hurt, and they die only with the Hydra; the health bar is always the Hydra's.

steps.title: The Chimera: three heads, three ways to fight
steps.text: The Chimera - a lion in front, a goat's head rising from its back, a serpent for a tail - is cut from your top view into its body, the three heads and three legs. Every head fights its own way: the lion roars rings of flame, the goat sprays curling embers, the serpent spits venom that curves in on you. Its specials: the lion breathes a cone of fire that sweeps across you (an arc shows where it will go), the goat lowers its horns and the beast charges, and rearing up in your front view all three fire at once.

steps.title: Charybdis, the whirlpool
steps.text: Charybdis - the whirlpool that swallows the sea - is your picture kept whole and brought to life by a shader: the creature turns slowly, its vortex spins inside the ring of teeth (fastest at the eye, still at the teeth), and the tentacles and spray at its rim writhe. It spins arms of waves, lashes waves from its eight tentacles, and draws rings of bubbles in from around you. In its whirlpool it drags you toward its maw at 85 % of your top speed - fly straight out at full speed to escape; reach the maw and it bites and throws you clear. Then it swells and spews the swallowed sea back out.

steps.title: They hunt you
steps.text: Creatures no longer give up: once a creature has seen you it chases you anywhere, always as fast as your ship (upgrades included). Leave its signal while it lives and a few seconds later it comes out of the void after you, into the system - as hurt as you left it - attacking any NPC ship in its path (its bullets hit them too). Kill it there for the signal's loot; go back into its signal and it's waiting; jump to another system and you've lost it.

steps.title: Signal levels, and room for the loot
steps.text: Every signal now has a level - easy, moderate, hard or insane - shown on its beacon (with one to four pips), in the scan, the tooltip and its panel. The level multiplies its hostiles' hull, shields and damage, and its hazards' burn - and its rewards. Cargo holds are much roomier, so one encounter's loot never fills you up: the starting fighter holds 150 (was 60), every class far more than before, a cargo rack adds 40; and a huge creature's combat loot is capped at 11 rolls.

steps.title: Playtested, and fixed
steps.text: Every creature was fought to the kill by a playtest bot with the starting ship (Cetus 85 s, Echidna 86 s, the Chimera 90 s, Charybdis 157 s, no deaths), and the whole main quest and home missions were played through. Fixes: docking while your ship was still undocking was ignored - it now waits and docks; when the Hydra died its double heads all grabbed the camera at once and sent it jumping - now one dying creature at a time takes it, and small ones leave it alone; and a playtest's window can be placed where you want it (the game no longer re-centres it).

+	meta = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(ART + ".json"))
+	art_scale = length * 1.45 / 1774.0
+	_rig = Node2D.new()
+	_rig.scale = Vector2.ONE * art_scale
+	_rig.rotation = PI / 2.0   # (the art's head points left; the creature's forward is -y)
+	add_child(_rig)
+	var hub := _v(meta["hub"])
+	_joint("fin_top", hub)
+	_joint("fin_bottom", hub)
+	_bodyspr = _part("body", hub)
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = SWIM_SHADER
+	m.set_shader_parameter("tex_size", _bodyspr.texture.get_size())
+	m.set_shader_parameter("head_x", float(meta["head_x"]) - float(meta["parts"]["body"][0]))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("body_len", 1500.0)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("amp", AMP)
+	_bodyspr.material = m
+	_rig.add_child(_bodyspr)
+	_joint("tail", hub)
+	# The breach: the side view, upright, hidden until it leaps.
+	_side = Sprite2D.new()
+	_side.texture = load(ART + "_side.png")
+	_side.visible = false
+	_side.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS
+	_side.top_level = true
+	_side.z_index = 3
+	add_child(_side)
+	_over = Node2D.new()
+	_over.top_level = true
+	_over.z_index = 2
+	_over.draw.connect(_draw_over)
+	add_child(_over)
+
+
+func _v(a: Array) -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2(float(a[0]), float(a[1]))
+
+
+func _part(part: String, origin: Vector2) -> Sprite2D:
+	var s := Sprite2D.new()
+	s.name = part
+	s.texture = load(ART + "_" + part + ".png")
+	s.centered = false
+	s.position = _v(meta["parts"][part]) - origin
+	s.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS
+	return s
+
+
+func _joint(part: String, hub: Vector2) -> void:
+	var piv := _v(meta[part + "_pivot"])
+	var j := Node2D.new()
+	j.position = piv - hub
+	_rig.add_child(j)
+	j.add_child(_part(part, piv))
+	_joints[part] = j
+
+
+## The body's sideways offset (art px) at art x - the shader's curve.
+func bend(x: float) -> float:
+	var s := clampf((x - float(meta["head_x"])) / 1500.0, 0.0, 1.0)
+	return AMP * pow(s, 1.6) * sin(s * TAU * 0.8 - _phase)
+
+
+## The top view (1774 x 887 art px) - its shield is a sphere round its length.
+func visual_size() -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2(1774, 887) * length * 1.45 / 1774.0
+
+
+## Its maw (world): the bubbles and waves come from there.
+func mouth() -> Vector2:
+	if meta.is_empty() or _rig == null:
+		return super()
+	return _rig.to_global(_v(meta["mouth"]) - _v(meta["hub"]))
+
+
+func _charge() -> float:
+	if demo:
+		return smoothstep(0.55, 0.85, sin(_t * 0.7))
+	if special != "":
+		return 1.0
+	if pattern == "":
+		return 0.0
+	return clampf(1.0 + _pt / CHARGE, 0.0, 1.0) if _pt < 0.0 else 1.0
+
+
+func pattern_pool() -> Array:
+	return POOLS[fight_stage()]
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if special != "" and not dying:
+		_t += delta
+		_run_special(delta)
+	else:
+		var was := pattern
+		super(delta)
+		if was == "" and pattern != "" and not dying:
+			var kind: String = SEQUENCE[_attacks % SEQUENCE.size()]
+			_attacks += 1
+			var tgt := _target()
+			if kind == "dive" and tgt != null:
+				pattern = ""
+				special = "dive"
+				_sp = 0.0
+				_breach_hit = false
+				_from = _centre()
+				Sfx.play_world("space/monster_roar", global_position, -6.0, 0.4)
+	if _rig == null:
+		return
+	# Swimming: the stroke faster while it charges.
+	var charge := _charge()
+	_phase += delta * (2.4 + 1.6 * charge)
+	(_bodyspr.material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("phase", _phase)
+	var tail_x := float(meta["tail_pivot"][0])
+	var hub := _v(meta["hub"])
+	_joints["tail"].position = Vector2(tail_x - hub.x, float(meta["tail_pivot"][1]) - hub.y + bend(tail_x))
+	_joints["tail"].rotation = atan((bend(tail_x + 30.0) - bend(tail_x - 30.0)) / 60.0) * 1.8 + 0.12 * sin(_phase - 1.2)
+	for f in ["fin_top", "fin_bottom"]:
+		var sgn := -1.0 if f == "fin_top" else 1.0
+		var px := float(meta[f + "_pivot"][0])
+		_joints[f].position = Vector2(px - hub.x, float(meta[f + "_pivot"][1]) - hub.y + bend(px))
+		_joints[f].rotation = sgn * (0.16 * sin(_phase * 0.9) + 0.1 * charge)
+	if _over:
+		_over.global_position = _centre()
+		_over.queue_redraw()
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _centre() -> Vector2:
+	return enemy.global_position if enemy and is_instance_valid(enemy) else global_position
+
+
+## The dive: sink, slide under toward you (submerged), a ring where you were,
+## breach there.
+func _run_special(delta: float) -> void:
+	var tgt := _target()
+	_sp += delta
+	var t1 := SINK
+	var t2 := SINK + SUBMERGED
+	var t3 := t2 + WARN
+	var t4 := t3 + BREACH
+	if _sp < t1:
+		_rig.modulate.a = 1.0 - _sp / SINK * 0.9
+	elif _sp < t2:
+		_rig.modulate.a = 0.1
+		if tgt and enemy and is_instance_valid(enemy):   # sliding under toward you
+			enemy.global_position = enemy.global_position.move_toward(tgt.global_position, 700.0 * delta)
+			_to = tgt.global_position
+	elif _sp < t3:
+		_rig.modulate.a = 0.0   # (the ring is fixed: where you were)
+		if enemy and is_instance_valid(enemy):
+			enemy.global_position = _to
+	elif _sp < t4:
+		var u := (_sp - t3) / BREACH
+		if not _breach_hit:
+			_breach_hit = true
+			_side.visible = true
+			Sfx.play_world("space/monster_roar", _to, 0.0, 0.1)
+			if tgt and tgt.global_position.distance_to(_to) < BREACH_RADIUS + float(tgt.get("hit_radius")) * 0.5:
+				tgt.take_damage(BREACH_DAMAGE, _to, enemy)
+			for i in 16:   # a burst of breaking waves, rolling out from the ring
+				var d := Vector2.from_angle(i * TAU / 16.0)
+				_shot(d * 160.0, SEA, "wave", _to + d * BREACH_RADIUS)
+		# The leap: the side view rising out of the void and falling back.
+		var arc := sin(u * PI)
+		var k := length * 1.3 / 1604.0
+		_side.global_position = _to + Vector2(0, -arc * length * 0.5)
+		_side.scale = Vector2.ONE * k * (0.6 + 0.5 * arc)
+		_side.rotation = lerpf(-0.35, 0.45, u)
+		_side.modulate.a = clampf(arc * 2.0, 0.0, 1.0)
+		_rig.modulate.a = clampf((u - 0.6) / 0.4, 0.0, 1.0)
+	else:
+		_side.visible = false
+		_rig.modulate.a = 1.0
+		specials_done["dive"] = int(specials_done.get("dive", 0)) + 1
+		special = ""
+		_cool = PAUSE
+
+
+## Above everything (relative to it): the dive's ripples, its shadow under the
+## void, the breach ring.
+func _draw_over() -> void:
+	if special != "dive":
+		return
+	var o := _over.global_position
+	var t2 := SINK + SUBMERGED
+	var t3 := t2 + WARN
+	if _sp < SINK:
+		for k in 3:
+			var r := length * (0.3 + 0.25 * k) * (_sp / SINK)
+			_over.draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, r, 0, TAU, 48, Color(FOAM, 0.5 * (1.0 - _sp / SINK)), 3.0, true)
+	elif _sp < t2:
+		_over.draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, (_to - o).angle(), Vector2(1.0, 0.45))
+		_over.draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, length * 0.6, Color(0.0, 0.05, 0.12, 0.35))
+		_over.draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO)
+	elif _sp < t3:
+		var u := (_sp - t2) / WARN
+		var c := _to - o
+		_over.draw_circle(c, BREACH_RADIUS, Color(SEA, 0.08 + 0.12 * u))
+		_over.draw_arc(c, BREACH_RADIUS, 0, TAU, 64, Color(FOAM, 0.4 + 0.5 * u), 4.0, true)
+		_over.draw_arc(c, BREACH_RADIUS * u, 0, TAU, 64, Color(FOAM, 0.6), 2.0, true)
+
+
+## On the body: its golden eyes glowing (blazing as it charges).
+func _draw() -> void:
+	if meta.is_empty() or _rig == null:
+		return
+	var charge := _charge()
+	var pulse := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * 3.0)
+	for e in meta["eyes"]:
+		var p := to_local(_rig.to_global(_v(e) - _v(meta["hub"])))
+		draw_circle(p, (10.0 + 8.0 * charge) * art_scale * 2.5, Color(GOLD, (0.15 + 0.08 * pulse + 0.3 * charge) * _rig.modulate.a))
+
+
+## Its own bullet patterns: waves and bubbles.
+func _pattern_step(name: String, delta: float, aim: float) -> float:
+	var st := fight_stage()
+	var spd := 1.0 + 0.08 * st
+	match name:
+		"tidal_ring":   # rings of breaking waves rolling out, each with a gap
+			for k in 3:
+				if _crossed(k * 0.6):
+					var n := 18 + st * 2
+					var gap := randi() % n
+					for i in n:
+						if absi(i - gap) > 1:
+							_shot(Vector2.from_angle(i * TAU / n + k * 0.17) * 130.0 * spd, SEA, "wave")
+			return 1.6
+		"spout":   # jets of bubbles from the maw, three bursts, aimed
+			_emit -= delta
+			while _emit <= 0.0 and _pt < 1.5:
+				_emit += 0.07
+				_shot(Vector2.from_angle(aim + randf_range(-0.12, 0.12)) * 215.0 * spd, FOAM, "bubble")
+			return 1.6
+		"undertow":   # bubbles flung wide that curl back toward the middle
+			for k in 2:
+				if _crossed(k * 0.7):
+					for i in 14:
+						var side := -1.0 if i < 7 else 1.0
+						var o := _shot(Vector2.from_angle(aim + side * (0.9 + (i % 7) * 0.12)) * 170.0 * spd, FOAM, "bubble")
+						o.curve = -side * 0.6
+			return 1.5
+		"whirl":   # a whirl of waves, two arms turning
+			_emit -= delta
+			while _emit <= 0.0 and _pt < 2.2:
+				_emit += 0.12
+				_spin += 0.3
+				for arm in 2:
+					_shot(Vector2.from_angle(_spin + arm * PI) * 150.0 * spd, SEA, "wave").curve = 0.25
+			return 2.3
+		"deluge":   # rings of waves with jets of bubbles between them
+			for k in 4:
+				if _crossed(k * 0.5):
+					var gap := randi() % 22
+					for i in 22:
+						if absi(i - gap) > 1:
+							_shot(Vector2.from_angle(i * TAU / 22.0) * 125.0, SEA, "wave")
+					for j in 4:
+						_shot(Vector2.from_angle(aim + (j - 1.5) * 0.08) * 220.0, FOAM, "bubble")
+			return 2.1
+	return super(name, delta, aim)
+
+
+func calm() -> void:
+	super()
+	if _side:
+		_side.visible = false
+	if _rig:
+		_rig.modulate.a = 1.0
+
+
+func death_throes() -> void:
+	special = ""
+	if _side:
+		_side.visible = false
+	if _rig:
+		_rig.modulate.a = 1.0
+	await super()

@@ -1,0 +1,294 @@ 
+class_name CharybdisBeast
+extends SpaceMonster
+## Charybdis, the whirlpool that swallows the sea three times a day and spews
+## it out again - a creature of the monster signals (SignalSite.CREATURES).
+## The reference art itself (external/images/charybdis/charybdis_top.png, cut
+## by tools/charybdis_parts.py), whole: it turns slowly as a whirlpool does, its
+## vortex spinning inside the ring of teeth (the eye fastest) and the
+## tentacles and spray at its rim writhing (shaders/charybdis_whirl.gdshader).
+## Attacks, in turn (SEQUENCE):
+##   orbs      its own patterns (POOLS, denser by fight_stage): spiral arms of
+##             waves, the undertow (bubbles from all round, drawn into its maw),
+##             its tentacles lashing waves, rings of waves whirling;
+##   whirlpool it churns (WHIRL_WINDUP s) and drags everything toward its maw
+##             (PULL x your top speed, less further out - fly away at full
+##             speed and you just get out), currents
+##             spiralling in; reach its maw and it bites: MAW_DAMAGE, and you're
+##             thrown clear;
+##   spew      it swells (SPEW_WINDUP s) and spews the swallowed sea back out:
+##             waves and bubbles bursting every way, three times.
+
+const ART := "res://data/sprites/monster_charybdis"
+const WHIRL_SHADER := preload("res://shaders/charybdis_whirl.gdshader")
+const SEA := Color(0.25, 0.6, 1.0)
+const FOAM := Color(0.8, 0.95, 1.0)
+const SEQUENCE := ["orbs", "whirlpool", "orbs", "spew", "orbs", "whirlpool", "spew"]
+const POOLS := [["maelstrom", "undertow", "lash"], ["maelstrom", "undertow", "lash", "whirl_rings"], ["whirl_rings", "maelstrom", "undertow", "lash"]]
+const TURN := 0.12                  # rad/s: the whole whirlpool turning
+const WHIRL_WINDUP := 0.8
+const WHIRL_TIME := 4.0
+const PULL := 0.85                  # x the dragged ship's top speed, toward its maw (full speed away just gets out)
+const PULL_REACH := 2000.0
+const MAW_DAMAGE := 30.0
+const SPEW_WINDUP := 0.9
+const SPEW_TIME := 1.6
+
+var meta := {}
+var art_scale := 0.4
+var demo := false
+var special := ""
+var specials_done := {}
+var _sp := 0.0
+var _rig: Node2D
+var _spr: Sprite2D
+var _mat: ShaderMaterial
+var _over: Node2D
+var _attacks := 0
+var _eye := 0.0                     # rad the vortex's eye has turned
+var _writhe := 0.0
+var _churn := 0.0
+var _bit := 0.0                     # cooldown after a bite
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	super()
+	glow = SEA
+	meta = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(ART + ".json"))
+	art_scale = length * 1.5 / 1352.0
+	_rig = Node2D.new()
+	_rig.scale = Vector2.ONE * art_scale
+	add_child(_rig)
+	_spr = Sprite2D.new()
+	_spr.texture = load(ART + ".png")
+	_spr.centered = false
+	var centre := _v(meta["centre"]) - _v(meta["origin"])   # (texture px)
+	_spr.position = -centre
+	_spr.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS
+	_mat = ShaderMaterial.new()
+	_mat.shader = WHIRL_SHADER
+	_mat.set_shader_parameter("tex_size", _spr.texture.get_size())
+	_mat.set_shader_parameter("centre", centre)
+	_mat.set_shader_parameter("vortex", float(meta["vortex"]))
+	_mat.set_shader_parameter("reach", float(meta["reach"]))
+	_spr.material = _mat
+	_rig.add_child(_spr)
+	_over = Node2D.new()
+	_over.top_level = true
+	_over.z_index = 2
+	_over.draw.connect(_draw_over)
+	add_child(_over)
+
+
+func _v(a: Array) -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2(float(a[0]), float(a[1]))
+
+
+## The picture (1352 x 1082 art px).
+func visual_size() -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2(1352, 1082) * length * 1.5 / 1352.0
+
+
+## Its maw: the eye of the vortex - everything comes from there.
+func mouth() -> Vector2:
+	return global_position
+
+
+## World px: the ring of teeth.
+func maw_radius() -> float:
+	return float(meta.get("maw", 255)) * art_scale
+
+
+func _charge() -> float:
+	if demo:
+		return smoothstep(0.55, 0.85, sin(_t * 0.7))
+	if special != "":
+		return 1.0
+	if pattern == "":
+		return 0.0
+	return clampf(1.0 + _pt / CHARGE, 0.0, 1.0) if _pt < 0.0 else 1.0
+
+
+func pattern_pool() -> Array:
+	return POOLS[fight_stage()]
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if special != "" and not dying:
+		_t += delta
+		_run_special(delta)
+	else:
+		var was := pattern
+		super(delta)
+		if was == "" and pattern != "" and not dying:
+			var kind: String = SEQUENCE[_attacks % SEQUENCE.size()]
+			_attacks += 1
+			if kind != "orbs" and _target() != null:
+				pattern = ""
+				special = kind
+				_sp = 0.0
+				Sfx.play_world("space/monster_roar", global_position, -3.0, 0.2)
+	_bit = maxf(0.0, _bit - delta)
+	if _rig == null:
+		return
+	var charge := _charge()
+	var whirling := special == "whirlpool" and _sp >= WHIRL_WINDUP
+	_churn = move_toward(_churn, 1.0 if whirling else (0.4 * charge), delta * 1.5)
+	_rig.global_rotation += TURN * (1.0 + 2.0 * _churn) * delta
+	_eye += delta * (1.4 + 4.0 * _churn)
+	_writhe += delta * (1.8 + 2.0 * _churn)
+	var swell := 0.0
+	if special == "spew":
+		swell = smoothstep(0.0, SPEW_WINDUP, _sp) * (1.0 - smoothstep(SPEW_WINDUP, SPEW_WINDUP + 0.3, _sp))
+	_rig.scale = Vector2.ONE * art_scale * (1.0 + 0.015 * sin(_t * 1.3) + 0.08 * swell)
+	_mat.set_shader_parameter("spin", _eye)
+	_mat.set_shader_parameter("writhe", _writhe)
+	_mat.set_shader_parameter("churn", _churn)
+	if _over:
+		_over.global_position = global_position
+		_over.queue_redraw()
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _run_special(delta: float) -> void:
+	var tgt := _target()
+	_sp += delta
+	match special:
+		"whirlpool":
+			if _sp >= WHIRL_WINDUP:
+				# Everything near drawn in, spiralling (you can fly out at full speed).
+				for s in _pulled():
+					var rel: Vector2 = global_position - s.global_position
+					var d := rel.length()
+					if d < PULL_REACH and d > 1.0:
+						var k := 1.0 - d / PULL_REACH * 0.4
+						var pull: float = PULL * float(s.get("max_speed") if s.get("max_speed") != null else 400.0) * k
+						s.global_position += (rel / d * pull + rel.orthogonal() / d * pull * 0.3) * delta
+				if tgt and _bit <= 0.0 and tgt.global_position.distance_to(global_position) < maw_radius() * 0.75:
+					_bit = 1.5
+					tgt.take_damage(MAW_DAMAGE, global_position, enemy)
+					Effects.spark(tgt.global_position, FOAM)
+					Sfx.play_world("space/monster_roar", global_position, 0.0, 0.5)
+					tgt.global_position = global_position + (tgt.global_position - global_position).normalized() * maw_radius() * 2.2
+				# The currents carry bubbles in from all round.
+				if fmod(_sp, 0.25) < delta:
+					for i in 6:
+						var a := randf() * TAU
+						var o := _shot(Vector2.from_angle(a + PI * 0.6) * 120.0, FOAM, "bubble", global_position + Vector2.from_angle(a) * maw_radius() * 3.2)
+						o.home = 0.0
+						o.curve = 0.5
+			if _sp >= WHIRL_WINDUP + WHIRL_TIME:
+				_end_special()
+		"spew":
+			for w in 3:
+				if _sp >= SPEW_WINDUP + w * 0.45 and _sp - delta < SPEW_WINDUP + w * 0.45:
+					Sfx.play_world("space/monster_roar", global_position, -2.0, 0.6)
+					var n := 20 + 2 * fight_stage()
+					var off := randf() * TAU
+					for i in n:
+						_shot(Vector2.from_angle(off + i * TAU / n) * 160.0, SEA, "wave", global_position + Vector2.from_angle(off + i * TAU / n) * maw_radius() * 0.8)
+					for i in 10:
+						_shot(Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * randf_range(120.0, 220.0), FOAM, "bubble", global_position + Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * maw_radius() * 0.5)
+			if _sp >= SPEW_WINDUP + SPEW_TIME:
+				_end_special()
+
+
+## Who the whirlpool drags: you, and any ship near.
+func _pulled() -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var p := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player") as Node2D
+	if p and p.is_alive():
+		out.append(p)
+	for n in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("neutrals"):
+		if n.is_alive():
+			out.append(n)
+	return out
+
+
+func _end_special() -> void:
+	specials_done[special] = int(specials_done.get(special, 0)) + 1
+	special = ""
+	_cool = PAUSE
+
+
+## Above everything (relative to it): the whirlpool's currents spiralling in;
+## the spew's swell.
+func _draw_over() -> void:
+	if special == "whirlpool":
+		var on := smoothstep(0.0, WHIRL_WINDUP, _sp) * (1.0 - smoothstep(WHIRL_WINDUP + WHIRL_TIME - 0.5, WHIRL_WINDUP + WHIRL_TIME, _sp))
+		for arm in 6:
+			var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+			for i in 24:
+				var u := float(i) / 23.0
+				var r := lerpf(maw_radius() * 0.9, PULL_REACH * 0.85, u)
+				var a := arm * TAU / 6.0 - _t * 2.2 + u * 3.2
+				pts.append(Vector2.from_angle(a) * r)
+			_over.draw_polyline(pts, Color(FOAM, 0.28 * on), 3.0, true)
+		_over.draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, maw_radius() * 0.75, 0, TAU, 48, Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.2, 0.35 * on), 3.0, true)
+	elif special == "spew" and _sp < SPEW_WINDUP:
+		var u := _sp / SPEW_WINDUP
+		_over.draw_arc(Vector2.ZERO, maw_radius() * (0.5 + 0.6 * u), 0, TAU, 48, Color(FOAM, 0.2 + 0.5 * u), 4.0, true)
+
+
+## Its eye glowing as it gathers.
+func _draw() -> void:
+	var charge := _charge()
+	var pulse := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_t * 2.5)
+	draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, maw_radius() * (0.25 + 0.15 * charge), Color(0.4, 0.8, 1.0, 0.06 + 0.04 * pulse + 0.2 * charge))
+
+
+## Its own bullet patterns: waves and bubbles, round and round.
+func _pattern_step(name: String, delta: float, aim: float) -> float:
+	var st := fight_stage()
+	var spd := 1.0 + 0.08 * st
+	match name:
+		"maelstrom":   # spiral arms of waves, turning
+			_emit -= delta
+			while _emit <= 0.0 and _pt < 2.2:
+				_emit += 0.12
+				_spin_p += 0.21
+				for arm in 3 + st:
+					var a := _spin_p + arm * TAU / (3 + st)
+					_shot(Vector2.from_angle(a) * 150.0 * spd, SEA, "wave", global_position + Vector2.from_angle(a) * maw_radius() * 0.6).curve = 0.3
+			return 2.3
+		"undertow":   # bubbles from all round you, drawn in toward its maw
+			for k in 2:
+				if _crossed(k * 0.9):
+					var tgt := _target()
+					if tgt == null:
+						continue
+					var n := 14 + st * 2
+					var gap := randi() % n
+					for i in n:
+						if absi(i - gap) > 1 and absi(i - gap) != n - 1:
+							var d := Vector2.from_angle(i * TAU / n)
+							var from := tgt.global_position + d * 520.0
+							_shot((global_position - from).normalized() * 110.0 * spd, FOAM, "bubble", from)
+			return 2.2
+		"lash":   # its tentacles lash: a fan of waves from each of eight
+			for k in 2:
+				if _crossed(k * 0.7):
+					for t in 8:
+						var a := _rig.global_rotation + t * TAU / 8.0 + k * 0.2
+						var from := global_position + Vector2.from_angle(a) * float(meta["reach"]) * art_scale * 0.8
+						for i in 3:
+							_shot(Vector2.from_angle(a + (i - 1) * 0.25) * 170.0 * spd, SEA, "wave", from)
+			return 1.6
+		"whirl_rings":   # rings of waves whirling out, each with a gap
+			for k in 3:
+				if _crossed(k * 0.6):
+					var n := 18 + st * 2
+					var gap := randi() % n
+					for i in n:
+						if absi(i - gap) > 1 and absi(i - gap) != n - 1:
+							var o := _shot(Vector2.from_angle(i * TAU / n + k * 0.3) * 135.0 * spd, SEA, "wave", global_position + Vector2.from_angle(i * TAU / n) * maw_radius() * 0.7)
+							o.curve = 0.35
+			return 2.0
+	return super(name, delta, aim)
+
+
+var _spin_p := 0.0
+
+
+func death_throes() -> void:
+	special = ""
+	await super()

@@ -1,0 +1,377 @@ 
+class_name ChimeraBeast
+extends SpaceMonster
+## The Chimera - a lion in front, a goat's head rising from its back, a
+## serpent for a tail - a creature of the monster signals
+## (SignalSite.CREATURES). The reference art itself (external/images/chimera/),
+## cut by tools/chimera_parts.py: from the top view its body, the lion's head,
+## the goat's head, the serpent tail and three legs; the front view whole.
+## It stays upright on screen as in the art: the lion snarls, the goat tosses
+## its horns, the serpent sways and strikes, the legs paw. Each head fights its
+## own way - the lion with fire, the goat with embers, the serpent with venom.
+## Attacks, in turn (SEQUENCE) - the breath and the ram aim at you while it
+## winds up, then commit:
+##   orbs     its own patterns (POOLS, denser by fight_stage);
+##   breath   the lion draws breath (BREATH_WINDUP s, a faint cone following you)
+##            and breathes fire, the cone sweeping across (BREATH_SWEEP rad over
+##            BREATH_TIME s): BREATH_DPS while you're in it;
+##   ram      the goat lowers its horns (an arrow following you) and the beast
+##            charges where you were (RAM_SPEED), RAM_DAMAGE, embers in its wake;
+##   rampage  it rears up (the front view rising over it) and all three heads
+##            fire at once: a ring of flame, a burst of embers, venom at you.
+
+const ART := "res://data/sprites/monster_chimera"
+const FIRE := Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.1)
+const EMBER := Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.3)
+const VENOM := Color(0.55, 1.0, 0.25)
+const SEQUENCE := ["orbs", "breath", "orbs", "ram", "orbs", "rampage", "breath", "orbs", "ram"]
+const POOLS := [["lion_roar", "goat_embers", "serpent_spit"], ["three_heads", "lion_roar", "serpent_spit", "goat_embers"], ["chimera_storm", "three_heads", "lion_roar", "serpent_spit"]]
+const LEGS := ["front_left_leg", "front_right_leg", "back_right_leg"]
+const BREATH_WINDUP := 0.8
+const BREATH_TIME := 1.6
+const BREATH_LENGTH := 760.0
+const BREATH_HALF := 0.24
+const BREATH_SWEEP := 0.9
+const BREATH_DPS := 40.0
+const RAM_WINDUP := 0.75
+const RAM_TIME := 0.65
+const RAM_SPEED := 1100.0
+const RAM_DAMAGE := 28.0
+const RAMPAGE_WINDUP := 0.9
+const RAMPAGE_TIME := 1.6
+
+var meta := {}
+var art_scale := 0.4
+var demo := false
+var special := ""
+var specials_done := {}
+var _sp := 0.0
+var _aim := 0.0
+var _side := 1.0                    # which way the breath sweeps
+var _ram_hit := false
+var _rig: Node2D
+var _body: Node2D
+var _joints := {}
+var _front: Sprite2D
+var _over: Node2D
+var _attacks := 0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	super()
+	glow = FIRE
+	meta = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(ART + ".json"))
+	art_scale = length * 1.5 / 1536.0
+	_rig = Node2D.new()
+	_rig.scale = Vector2.ONE * art_scale
+	add_child(_rig)
+	var hub := _v(meta["hub"])
+	_body = Node2D.new()
+	_rig.add_child(_body)
+	_joint("serpent", hub)
+	_joint("back_right_leg", hub)
+	_body.add_child(_part("body", hub))
+	_joint("goat", hub)
+	_joint("front_left_leg", hub)
+	_joint("front_right_leg", hub)
+	_joint("lion", hub)
+	_front = Sprite2D.new()
+	_front.texture = load(ART + "_front.png")
+	_front.visible = false
+	_front.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS
+	_front.top_level = true
+	_front.z_index = 3
+	add_child(_front)
+	_over = Node2D.new()
+	_over.top_level = true
+	_over.z_index = 2
+	_over.draw.connect(_draw_over)
+	add_child(_over)
+
+
+func _v(a: Array) -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2(float(a[0]), float(a[1]))
+
+
+func _part(part: String, origin: Vector2) -> Sprite2D:
+	var s := Sprite2D.new()
+	s.name = part
+	s.texture = load(ART + "_" + part + ".png")
+	s.centered = false
+	s.position = _v(meta["parts"][part]) - origin
+	s.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS
+	return s
+
+
+func _joint(part: String, hub: Vector2) -> void:
+	var piv := _v(meta[part + "_pivot"])
+	var j := Node2D.new()
+	j.position = piv - hub
+	_body.add_child(j)
+	j.add_child(_part(part, piv))
+	_joints[part] = j
+
+
+## The top view (1536 x 1024 art px), upright.
+func visual_size() -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2(1536, 1024) * length * 1.5 / 1536.0
+
+
+## The jaws of "lion", "goat" or "serpent" (world).
+func jaw(head: String) -> Vector2:
+	if meta.is_empty() or _rig == null:
+		return global_position
+	var j: Node2D = _joints[head]
+	return j.to_global(_v(meta["mouths"][head]) - _v(meta[head + "_pivot"]))
+
+
+func mouth() -> Vector2:
+	return jaw("lion")
+
+
+func _centre() -> Vector2:
+	return enemy.global_position if enemy and is_instance_valid(enemy) else global_position
+
+
+func _charge() -> float:
+	if demo:
+		return smoothstep(0.55, 0.85, sin(_t * 0.7))
+	if special != "":
+		return 1.0
+	if pattern == "":
+		return 0.0
+	return clampf(1.0 + _pt / CHARGE, 0.0, 1.0) if _pt < 0.0 else 1.0
+
+
+func pattern_pool() -> Array:
+	return POOLS[fight_stage()]
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if special != "" and not dying:
+		_t += delta
+		_run_special(delta)
+	else:
+		var was := pattern
+		super(delta)
+		if was == "" and pattern != "" and not dying:
+			var kind: String = SEQUENCE[_attacks % SEQUENCE.size()]
+			_attacks += 1
+			var tgt := _target()
+			if kind != "orbs" and tgt != null:
+				pattern = ""
+				special = kind
+				_sp = 0.0
+				_ram_hit = false
+				_side = -_side
+				_aim = (tgt.global_position - (jaw("lion") if kind == "breath" else _centre())).angle()
+				Sfx.play_world("space/monster_roar", global_position, -4.0, 0.25)
+	if _over:
+		_over.global_position = _centre()   # (drawn relative to it: far out, world numbers lose precision)
+		_over.queue_redraw()
+	if _rig == null:
+		return
+	_rig.global_rotation = 0.0
+	var charge := _charge()
+	_body.position = Vector2(sin(_t * 0.8) * 3.0, sin(_t * 1.6) * 4.0 + charge * 8.0) / art_scale
+	_body.scale = Vector2.ONE * (1.0 + 0.012 * sin(_t * 1.9))
+	var breathing := special == "breath" and _sp >= BREATH_WINDUP
+	_joints["lion"].rotation = 0.05 * sin(_t * 1.3) + (0.06 * sin(_t * 25.0) if breathing else 0.0)
+	_joints["goat"].rotation = 0.08 * sin(_t * 1.7 + 1.0) + 0.06 * pow(maxf(0.0, sin(_t * 3.1)), 8.0) - (0.18 if special == "ram" and _sp < RAM_WINDUP else 0.0)
+	_joints["serpent"].rotation = 0.12 * sin(_t * 1.2) + 0.05 * sin(_t * 3.3) + 0.08 * charge * sin(_t * 9.0)
+	var i := 0
+	for l in LEGS:
+		_joints[l].rotation = 0.05 * sin(_t * 1.4 + i * 1.3) * (1.0 if i % 2 == 0 else -1.0)
+		i += 1
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _run_special(delta: float) -> void:
+	var tgt := _target()
+	_sp += delta
+	match special:
+		"breath":
+			if _sp < BREATH_WINDUP:
+				if tgt:
+					_aim = (tgt.global_position - jaw("lion")).angle() - _side * BREATH_SWEEP * 0.5
+			else:
+				if tgt:
+					var rel: Vector2 = tgt.global_position - jaw("lion")
+					if rel.length() < BREATH_LENGTH and absf(wrapf(rel.angle() - _breath_angle(), -PI, PI)) < BREATH_HALF:
+						tgt.take_damage(BREATH_DPS * delta, tgt.global_position, enemy)
+				if _sp > BREATH_WINDUP + BREATH_TIME:
+					_end_special()
+		"ram":
+			if _sp < RAM_WINDUP:
+				if tgt:
+					_aim = (tgt.global_position - _centre()).angle()
+			elif _sp < RAM_WINDUP + RAM_TIME:
+				if enemy and is_instance_valid(enemy):
+					enemy.global_position += Vector2.from_angle(_aim) * RAM_SPEED * delta
+					if randf() < 0.5:   # embers in its wake
+						_shot(Vector2.from_angle(_aim + PI + randf_range(-0.8, 0.8)) * 90.0, EMBER, "ember", jaw("goat"))
+					if tgt and not _ram_hit and tgt.global_position.distance_to(enemy.global_position) < length * 0.3 + float(tgt.get("hit_radius")):
+						_ram_hit = true
+						tgt.take_damage(RAM_DAMAGE, enemy.global_position, enemy)
+			else:
+				_end_special()
+		"rampage":
+			var k := length * 1.45 / 1146.0
+			var rise := smoothstep(0.0, RAMPAGE_WINDUP, _sp)
+			var fall := 1.0 - smoothstep(RAMPAGE_WINDUP + RAMPAGE_TIME - 0.5, RAMPAGE_WINDUP + RAMPAGE_TIME, _sp)
+			_front.visible = true
+			_front.global_position = global_position + Vector2(0, -length * 0.2 * rise)
+			_front.scale = Vector2.ONE * k * (0.85 + 0.2 * rise)
+			_front.modulate.a = rise * fall
+			_rig.modulate.a = 1.0 - 0.75 * rise * fall
+			for w in 2:
+				if _sp >= RAMPAGE_WINDUP + w * 0.7 and _sp - delta < RAMPAGE_WINDUP + w * 0.7:
+					var c := global_position
+					var a0 := (tgt.global_position - c).angle() if tgt else 0.0
+					var n := 18 + 2 * fight_stage()
+					var gap := randi() % n
+					for i in n:   # the lion: a ring of flame (with a gap)
+						if absi(i - gap) > 1 and absi(i - gap) != n - 1:
+							_shot(Vector2.from_angle(a0 + i * TAU / n + w * 0.17) * 150.0, FIRE, "flame", c)
+					for i in 12:   # the goat: a burst of embers
+						_shot(Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * randf_range(100.0, 180.0), EMBER, "ember", c + Vector2(-length * 0.2, -length * 0.15)).curve = randf_range(-0.5, 0.5)
+					for i in 3:   # the serpent: venom at you
+						_shot(Vector2.from_angle(a0 + (i - 1) * 0.12) * 230.0, VENOM, "venom", c + Vector2(length * 0.25, -length * 0.15))
+			if _sp >= RAMPAGE_WINDUP + RAMPAGE_TIME:
+				_front.visible = false
+				_rig.modulate.a = 1.0
+				_end_special()
+
+
+## The breath's angle now: sweeping across from where it aimed.
+func _breath_angle() -> float:
+	var u := clampf((_sp - BREATH_WINDUP) / BREATH_TIME, 0.0, 1.0)
+	return _aim + _side * BREATH_SWEEP * u
+
+
+func _end_special() -> void:
+	specials_done[special] = int(specials_done.get(special, 0)) + 1
+	special = ""
+	_cool = PAUSE
+
+
+## Above everything (relative to it): the breath's cone, the ram's arrow.
+func _draw_over() -> void:
+	var o := _over.global_position
+	if special == "breath":
+		var from := jaw("lion") - o
+		var a := _breath_angle()
+		if _sp < BREATH_WINDUP:
+			var k := _sp / BREATH_WINDUP
+			for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+				_over.draw_line(from, from + Vector2.from_angle(a + s * BREATH_HALF) * BREATH_LENGTH, Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.1, 0.15 + 0.35 * k), 2.0, true)
+			# (and where it will sweep to)
+			_over.draw_arc(from, BREATH_LENGTH, minf(a, a + _side * BREATH_SWEEP) - BREATH_HALF, maxf(a, a + _side * BREATH_SWEEP) + BREATH_HALF, 24, Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.1, 0.2 + 0.3 * k), 2.0, true)
+		else:
+			var u := _sp - BREATH_WINDUP
+			var fade := 1.0 - smoothstep(BREATH_TIME - 0.3, BREATH_TIME, u)
+			var pts := PackedVector2Array([from])
+			for i in 9:
+				pts.append(from + Vector2.from_angle(a - BREATH_HALF + 2.0 * BREATH_HALF * i / 8.0) * BREATH_LENGTH * (0.92 + 0.08 * sin(_t * 20.0 + i)))
+			_over.draw_colored_polygon(pts, Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.05, 0.22 * fade))
+			for i in 18:
+				var d := fposmod(u * 900.0 + i * BREATH_LENGTH / 18.0, BREATH_LENGTH)
+				var spread := sin(i * 2.3 + _t * 7.0) * BREATH_HALF * 0.8
+				var p := from + Vector2.from_angle(a + spread) * d
+				_over.draw_circle(p, 14.0 + d * 0.11, Color(1.0, 0.55 - d / BREATH_LENGTH * 0.35, 0.1, 0.45 * fade * (1.0 - d / BREATH_LENGTH * 0.5)))
+			_over.draw_circle(from, 24.0, Color(1.0, 0.9, 0.6, 0.85 * fade))
+	if special == "ram" and _sp < RAM_WINDUP:
+		var c0 := _centre() - o
+		var dir := Vector2.from_angle(_aim)
+		var reach := RAM_SPEED * RAM_TIME
+		var col := Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.3, 0.2 + 0.4 * _sp / RAM_WINDUP)
+		_over.draw_line(c0 + dir * length * 0.3, c0 + dir * reach, Color(col, col.a * 0.35), 70.0, true)
+		_over.draw_line(c0 + dir * length * 0.3, c0 + dir * reach, col, 4.0, true)
+		var tip := c0 + dir * reach
+		_over.draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([tip + dir * 40.0, tip + dir.orthogonal() * 30.0, tip - dir.orthogonal() * 30.0]), col)
+
+
+## On the body: each head's jaws glowing in its colour as it gathers.
+func _draw() -> void:
+	if meta.is_empty() or _rig == null:
+		return
+	var charge := _charge()
+	if charge <= 0.0:
+		return
+	for h in [["lion", FIRE], ["goat", EMBER], ["serpent", VENOM]]:
+		var p := to_local(jaw(h[0]))
+		draw_circle(p, (10.0 + 18.0 * charge) * art_scale * 3.0, Color(h[1], 0.22 * charge * _rig.modulate.a))
+		draw_circle(p, (4.0 + 6.0 * charge) * art_scale * 3.0, Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.7, 0.7 * charge * _rig.modulate.a))
+
+
+## Its own bullet patterns: each head its own.
+func _pattern_step(name: String, delta: float, aim: float) -> float:
+	var st := fight_stage()
+	var spd := 1.0 + 0.08 * st
+	match name:
+		"lion_roar":   # the lion roars rings of flame, a gap in each
+			for k in 3:
+				if _crossed(k * 0.55):
+					var n := 16 + st * 2
+					var gap := randi() % n
+					for i in n:
+						if absi(i - gap) > 1 and absi(i - gap) != n - 1:
+							_shot(Vector2.from_angle(i * TAU / n + k * 0.2) * 150.0 * spd, FIRE, "flame", jaw("lion"))
+			return 1.7
+		"goat_embers":   # the goat bleats out bursts of embers, curling
+			for k in 3:
+				if _crossed(k * 0.45):
+					for i in 18 + st * 4:
+						_shot(Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * randf_range(110.0, 190.0) * spd, EMBER, "ember", jaw("goat")).curve = randf_range(-0.6, 0.6)
+			return 1.4
+		"serpent_spit":   # the serpent strikes: streams of venom curving in on you
+			_emit -= delta
+			while _emit <= 0.0 and _pt < 1.4:
+				_emit += 0.1
+				var from := jaw("serpent")
+				var tgt := _target()
+				var a: float = (tgt.global_position - from).angle() if tgt else aim
+				for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+					_shot(Vector2.from_angle(a + s * 0.45) * 205.0 * spd, VENOM, "venom", from).curve = -s * 0.38
+			return 1.5
+		"three_heads":   # each head in turn: the lion's fan of flame, the goat's embers, the serpent's venom
+			for r in 3:
+				if _crossed(r * 0.75):
+					for i in 5:
+						_shot(Vector2.from_angle(aim + (i - 2) * 0.17) * 190.0 * spd, FIRE, "flame", jaw("lion"))
+				if _crossed(r * 0.75 + 0.25):
+					for i in 10:
+						_shot(Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * randf_range(120.0, 170.0), EMBER, "ember", jaw("goat"))
+				if _crossed(r * 0.75 + 0.5):
+					var from := jaw("serpent")
+					var tgt := _target()
+					var a: float = (tgt.global_position - from).angle() if tgt else aim
+					for i in 3:
+						_shot(Vector2.from_angle(a + (i - 1) * 0.1) * 230.0 * spd, VENOM, "venom", from)
+			return 2.3
+		"chimera_storm":   # all three heads spinning their fire, embers and venom round
+			_emit -= delta
+			while _emit <= 0.0 and _pt < 2.2:
+				_emit += 0.12
+				_spin += 0.27
+				_shot(Vector2.from_angle(_spin) * 165.0 * spd, FIRE, "flame", jaw("lion"))
+				_shot(Vector2.from_angle(_spin + TAU / 3.0) * 165.0 * spd, EMBER, "ember", jaw("goat"))
+				_shot(Vector2.from_angle(_spin + 2.0 * TAU / 3.0) * 165.0 * spd, VENOM, "venom", jaw("serpent"))
+			return 2.3
+	return super(name, delta, aim)
+
+
+func calm() -> void:
+	super()
+	if _front:
+		_front.visible = false
+	if _rig:
+		_rig.modulate.a = 1.0
+
+
+func death_throes() -> void:
+	special = ""
+	if _front:
+		_front.visible = false
+	if _rig:
+		_rig.modulate.a = 1.0

+class_name HydraBeast
+extends SpaceMonster
+## The Hydra of Lerna, the many-headed serpent - a creature of the monster
+## signals (SignalSite.CREATURES). The reference art itself
+## (external/images/hydra/), cut by tools/hydra_parts.py: from the top view
+## the knot of its coils and its eight heads; the front view whole. It stays
+## upright on screen as in the art; its heads sway and weave, each out of step,
+## and every one of them fires from its own jaws.
+## Cut off a head and two grow back: every PORTION of its hull lost, the head
+## nearest you is severed (a burst of venom from the stump) and a double head
+## (HydraHead) bursts out of the stump and keeps round the Hydra, spitting from both jaws - at most MAX_DOUBLE at once.
+## They can't be targeted or hurt (Enemy.untouchable; out of the "enemies"
+## group, so shots, targeting and the boss bar pass them by): they die only
+## with the Hydra. The severed head grows back REGROW s later.
+## Attacks, in turn (SEQUENCE):
+##   orbs    its own patterns (POOLS, denser by fight_stage): every head in turn
+##           spitting along its own neck, volleys of fangs from all the heads at
+##           you, drifting clouds of poison, a storm turning round all eight;
+##   bite    the head nearest you draws back (BITE_WINDUP s) and strikes at
+##           where you were (BITE_REACH), BITE_DAMAGE if it catches you - and
+##           spits a fan of fangs as it strikes;
+##   breath  it rears up out of the waves (the front view rising over it) and
+##           breathes poison: rings of miasma rolling out, a gap in each.
+
+const ART := "res://data/sprites/monster_hydra"
+const SCALES := Color(0.3, 0.45, 0.95)
+const VENOM := Color(0.55, 1.0, 0.25)
+const POISON := Color(0.4, 0.8, 0.2)
+const GOLD := Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.3)
+const SEQUENCE := ["orbs", "bite", "orbs", "breath", "orbs", "bite", "bite", "breath"]
+const POOLS := [["eight_heads", "volley", "miasma"], ["eight_heads", "volley", "miasma", "storm"], ["storm", "volley", "eight_heads", "miasma"]]
+const PORTION := 1.0 / 12.0         # of its hull: lose this much and a head is cut (and a double head grows)
+const MAX_DOUBLE := 12
+const DOUBLE_HULL := 0.1            # a double head's hull: this much of the Hydra's
+const REGROW := 6.0
+const BITE_WINDUP := 0.55
+const BITE_STRIKE := 0.18
+const BITE_HOLD := 0.15
+const BITE_BACK := 0.4
+const BITE_REACH := 300.0           # world px the head darts out at most
+const BITE_RADIUS := 95.0
+const BITE_DAMAGE := 24.0
+const BREATH_WINDUP := 0.9
+const BREATH_TIME := 1.8
+
+var meta := {}
+var art_scale := 0.4
+var demo := false
+var special := ""
+var specials_done := {}
+var severed := {}                   # head -> seconds until it grows back
+var heads_severed := 0
+var _sp := 0.0
+var _aim := 0.0
+var _rig: Node2D
+var _body: Node2D
+var _joints := {}
+var _base := {}                     # head -> its joint's rest position (art px)
+var _front: Sprite2D
+var _over: Node2D
+var _attacks := 0
+var _biter := ""
+var _bite_to := Vector2.ZERO        # where it strikes (world)
+var _bite_hit := false
+var _cuts := 0                      # PORTIONs of its hull lost so far
+var double_heads: Array = []        # its double heads (Enemy ships) alive
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	super()
+	glow = VENOM
+	meta = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(ART + ".json"))
+	art_scale = length * 1.5 / 1536.0
+	_rig = Node2D.new()
+	_rig.scale = Vector2.ONE * art_scale
+	add_child(_rig)
+	var hub := _v(meta["hub"])
+	_body = Node2D.new()
+	_rig.add_child(_body)
+	_body.add_child(_part("body", hub))
+	for h in meta["heads"]:
+		_joint(h, hub)
+	_front = Sprite2D.new()
+	_front.texture = load(ART + "_front.png")
+	_front.visible = false
+	_front.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS
+	_front.top_level = true
+	_front.z_index = 3
+	add_child(_front)
+	_over = Node2D.new()
+	_over.top_level = true
+	_over.z_index = 2
+	_over.draw.connect(_draw_over)
+	add_child(_over)
+
+
+func _v(a: Array) -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2(float(a[0]), float(a[1]))
+
+
+func _part(part: String, origin: Vector2) -> Sprite2D:
+	var s := Sprite2D.new()
+	s.name = part
+	s.texture = load(ART + "_" + part + ".png")
+	s.centered = false
+	s.position = _v(meta["parts"][part]) - origin
+	s.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS
+	return s
+
+
+func _joint(part: String, hub: Vector2) -> void:
+	var piv := _v(meta[part + "_pivot"])
+	var j := Node2D.new()
+	j.position = piv - hub
+	_body.add_child(j)
+	j.add_child(_part(part, piv))
+	_joints[part] = j
+	_base[part] = j.position
+
+
+## The top view (1536 x 1024 art px), upright.
+func visual_size() -> Vector2:
+	return Vector2(1536, 1024) * length * 1.5 / 1536.0
+
+
+## The heads still on their necks.
+func heads() -> Array:
+	return (meta.get("heads", []) as Array).filter(func(h): return not severed.has(h))
+
+
+## Head `h`'s jaws (world).
+func jaw(h: String) -> Vector2:
+	var j: Node2D = _joints[h]
+	var piv := _v(meta[h + "_pivot"])
+	return j.to_global(_v(meta["mouths"][h]) - piv)
+
+
+## Which way head `h` faces (world angle): from its neck to its jaws.
+func facing(h: String) -> float:
+	return (jaw(h) - _joints[h].global_position).angle()
+
+
+func mouth() -> Vector2:
+	if meta.is_empty() or _rig == null:
+		return super()
+	var hs := heads()
+	return jaw(hs[orbs_fired % hs.size()]) if not hs.is_empty() else global_position
+
+
+## The head nearest `p` (world).
+func nearest_head(p: Vector2) -> String:
+	var best := ""
+	var best_d := INF
+	for h in heads():
+		var d := jaw(h).distance_to(p)
+		if d < best_d:
+			best = h
+			best_d = d
+	return best
+
+
+func _charge() -> float:
+	if demo:
+		return smoothstep(0.55, 0.85, sin(_t * 0.7))
+	if special != "":
+		return 1.0
+	if pattern == "":
+		return 0.0
+	return clampf(1.0 + _pt / CHARGE, 0.0, 1.0) if _pt < 0.0 else 1.0
+
+
+func pattern_pool() -> Array:
+	return POOLS[fight_stage()]
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if special != "" and not dying:
+		_t += delta
+		_run_special(delta)
+	else:
+		var was := pattern
+		super(delta)
+		if was == "" and pattern != "" and not dying:
+			var kind: String = SEQUENCE[_attacks % SEQUENCE.size()]
+			_attacks += 1
+			var tgt := _target()
+			if kind != "orbs" and tgt != null and not heads().is_empty():
+				pattern = ""
+				special = kind
+				_sp = 0.0
+				_bite_hit = false
+				_biter = nearest_head(tgt.global_position)
+				Sfx.play_world("space/monster_roar", global_position, -5.0, 0.35)
+	if _rig == null:
+		return
+	_rig.global_rotation = 0.0
+	_run_heads(delta)
+	if _over:
+		_over.global_position = global_position
+		_over.queue_redraw()
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+## The heads weaving; cut off past each SEVER_AT; growing back.
+func _run_heads(delta: float) -> void:
+	var charge := _charge()
+	var i := 0
+	for h in meta["heads"]:
+		var j: Node2D = _joints[h]
+		if not (special == "bite" and h == _biter):
+			j.position = _base[h] + Vector2(sin(_t * 1.1 + i * 1.3), cos(_t * 0.9 + i * 0.7)) * 6.0
+			j.rotation = 0.08 * sin(_t * 1.5 + i * 0.8) + 0.05 * charge * sin(_t * 9.0 + i)
+		i += 1
+	# A head cut for every PORTION of hull lost (the one nearest you), growing back.
+	if enemy and is_instance_valid(enemy) and not dying and enemy.max_hull > 0.0:
+		var lost := int((1.0 - enemy.hull / enemy.max_hull) / PORTION)
+		if lost > _cuts and enemy.is_alive():
+			_cuts += 1   # (one a frame: a big hit cuts several, one after another)
+			var tgt := _target()
+			var h := nearest_head(tgt.global_position if tgt else global_position + Vector2(0, 400))
+			if h != "":
+				_sever(h)
+	for h in severed.keys():
+		severed[h] -= delta
+		var j: Node2D = _joints[h]
+		if severed[h] <= 0.0:
+			severed.erase(h)
+			j.visible = true
+			j.scale = Vector2.ONE * 0.2
+			j.create_tween().tween_property(j, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.8).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
+			Sfx.play_world("space/monster_roar", global_position, -6.0, 0.5)
+
+
+func _sever(h: String) -> void:
+	var at := jaw(h)
+	var stump: Vector2 = _joints[h].global_position
+	severed[h] = REGROW
+	heads_severed += 1
+	_joints[h].visible = false
+	if special == "bite" and h == _biter:
+		_end_special()
+	Effects.explosion(at, 1.0)
+	for i in 10:   # venom bursting from the stump
+		_shot(Vector2.from_angle(i * TAU / 10.0) * 150.0, VENOM, "venom", stump)
+	_grow_double(stump, h)
+
+
+## Two heads where one was cut: a double head (HydraHead), its own ship,
+## keeping its place round the Hydra (Enemy.leader).
+func _grow_double(at: Vector2, h: String) -> void:
+	double_heads = double_heads.filter(func(d): return is_instance_valid(d) and d.is_alive())
+	if double_heads.size() >= MAX_DOUBLE or enemy == null or not is_instance_valid(enemy):
+		GameLog.post("You cut off one of the Hydra's heads - it will grow back", "combat")
+		return
+	var main: Node = enemy
+	while main != null and not main.has_method("spawn_ship"):
+		main = main.get_parent()
+	if main == null:
+		return
+	var d: Node2D = main.spawn_ship(at, "hydra_head", {}, "pirates")
+	d.leader = enemy
+	d._led = true
+	d.max_hull = enemy.max_hull * DOUBLE_HULL
+	d.hull = d.max_hull
+	# Not to be fought: no target, no health bar, no loot - it dies with the Hydra.
+	d.untouchable = true
+	d.damage_mult = enemy.damage_mult
+	d.boss = false
+	d.click_radius = 0.0
+	d.remove_from_group(&"enemies")
+	if d.died.is_connected(main._on_ship_died):
+		d.died.disconnect(main._on_ship_died)
+	d.leader_slot = (at - global_position).angle()
+	d.hunting = true
+	d.home = at
+	double_heads.append(d)
+	GameLog.post("You cut off one of the Hydra's heads - and two grow in its place (%d)" % double_heads.size(), "combat")
+
+
+func _run_special(delta: float) -> void:
+	var tgt := _target()
+	_sp += delta
+	match special:
+		"bite":
+			var j: Node2D = _joints.get(_biter)
+			if j == null or severed.has(_biter):
+				_end_special()
+				return
+			var base: Vector2 = _base[_biter]
+			var t1 := BITE_WINDUP
+			var t2 := t1 + BITE_STRIKE
+			var t3 := t2 + BITE_HOLD
+			var t4 := t3 + BITE_BACK
+			if _sp < t1:   # drawing back, its aim following you
+				if tgt:
+					var from := jaw(_biter)
+					_bite_to = from + (tgt.global_position - from).limit_length(BITE_REACH)
+				var u := _sp / t1
+				j.position = base - _dart_dir(base) * 40.0 * u
+				j.rotation = 0.15 * sin(_sp * 30.0) * u
+			elif _sp < t3:
+				var u := clampf((_sp - t1) / BITE_STRIKE, 0.0, 1.0)
+				j.position = base + _dart(base) * u
+				j.rotation = 0.0
+				if u >= 1.0 and not _bite_hit:
+					_bite_hit = true
+					Sfx.play_world("space/monster_roar", _bite_to, -3.0, 0.6)
+					if tgt and tgt.global_position.distance_to(jaw(_biter)) < BITE_RADIUS + float(tgt.get("hit_radius")) * 0.5:
+						tgt.take_damage(BITE_DAMAGE, jaw(_biter), enemy)
+					var a := (_bite_to - global_position).angle()
+					for i in 7:
+						_shot(Vector2.from_angle(a + (i - 3) * 0.14) * 230.0, Color(1, 1, 1), "fang", jaw(_biter))
+			elif _sp < t4:
+				j.position = base + _dart(base) * (1.0 - (_sp - t3) / BITE_BACK)
+			else:
+				j.position = base
+				_end_special()
+		"breath":
+			var k := length * 1.45 / 1569.0
+			var rise := smoothstep(0.0, BREATH_WINDUP, _sp)
+			var fall := 1.0 - smoothstep(BREATH_WINDUP + BREATH_TIME - 0.5, BREATH_WINDUP + BREATH_TIME, _sp)
+			_front.visible = true
+			_front.global_position = global_position + Vector2(0, -length * 0.2 * rise)
+			_front.scale = Vector2.ONE * k * (0.85 + 0.2 * rise)
+			_front.modulate.a = rise * fall
+			_rig.modulate.a = 1.0 - 0.75 * rise * fall
+			for w in 3:
+				if _crossed_sp(BREATH_WINDUP + w * 0.55, delta):
+					var n := 20 + fight_stage() * 2
+					var gap := randi() % n
+					var a0 := (tgt.global_position - global_position).angle() if tgt else 0.0
+					for i in n:
+						if absi(i - gap) > 1 and absi(i - gap) != n - 1:
+							var o := _shot(Vector2.from_angle(a0 + i * TAU / n + w * 0.12) * 120.0, POISON, "miasma", global_position + Vector2.from_angle(a0 + i * TAU / n) * length * 0.3)
+							o.accel = -12.0
+			if _sp >= BREATH_WINDUP + BREATH_TIME:
+				_front.visible = false
+				_rig.modulate.a = 1.0
+				_end_special()
+
+
+## The bite's dart (art px, rig space): carrying the jaws from rest to where it strikes.
+func _dart(base: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	var jaw_rest := _rig.to_global(base + _v(meta["mouths"][_biter]) - _v(meta[_biter + "_pivot"]))
+	return (_bite_to - jaw_rest) / art_scale if art_scale > 0.0 else Vector2.ZERO
+
+
+func _dart_dir(base: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	var d := _dart(base)
+	return d.normalized() if d.length() > 0.01 else Vector2.ZERO
+
+
+func _crossed_sp(at: float, delta: float) -> bool:
+	return _sp >= at and _sp - delta < at
+
+
+func _end_special() -> void:
+	specials_done[special] = int(specials_done.get(special, 0)) + 1

+func _draw_over() -> void:

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Cetus (CetusBeast), the sea monster of the monster signals, cut out of the
+reference art (external/images/cetus/) into animatable parts - the pictures
+themselves, every line, shape and colour kept.
+
+  cetus_top.png   top view, head to the left: the creature as it swims
+  cetus_side.png  side view: shown when it breaches out of the void
+
+Steps: rembg's anime segmentation (isnet-anime) removes the background, and
+the deep purple background left inside the loops of spray is cleared by colour;
+from the top view the two pectoral fins and the tail fin are cut along polygons
+traced on the art (the body runs OVERLAP px under each), the rest is the body,
+which a shader bends as it swims; the side view stays whole.
+
+  data/sprites/monster_cetus_{body,fin_top,fin_bottom,tail,side}.png
+  data/sprites/monster_cetus.json   crop origins, pivots, mouth, eyes
+
+Needs the art venv (rembg, opencv, scipy):
+  ~/.local/share/space-atrapos-art/venv/bin/python tools/cetus_parts.py
+"""
+import json
+import os
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+ART = os.path.join(ROOT, "external", "images", "cetus")
+OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "sprites")
+PAD = 48
+OVERLAP = 30
+BG = np.array([63, 1, 78])        # the deep purple of the art's background
+
+PARTS = {
+    "fin_top": {"region": [(410, 190), (430, 120), (520, 40), (700, 5), (915, 15), (780, 110), (640, 200), (600, 250), (560, 272), (470, 262)],
+                "pivot": (520, 245)},
+    "fin_bottom": {"region": [(410, 697), (430, 767), (520, 847), (700, 882), (915, 872), (780, 777), (640, 687), (600, 637), (560, 615), (470, 625)],
+                   "pivot": (520, 642)},
+    "tail": {"region": [(1450, 330), (1540, 160), (1774, 120), (1774, 760), (1560, 720), (1450, 560)], "pivot": (1470, 443)},
+}
+MOUTH = (40, 435)
+EYES = [(255, 345), (255, 525)]
+HUB = (800, 443)                  # the middle of the body
+HEAD_X = 30                       # the snout (bending starts behind it)
+
+
+def cutout(path) -> np.ndarray:
+    from rembg import new_session, remove
+    orig = np.array(Image.open(path).convert("RGB"))
+    cut = np.array(remove(Image.fromarray(orig), session=new_session("isnet-anime")))
+    bg = np.sqrt(((orig.astype(int) - BG) ** 2).sum(axis=2)) < 48
+    cut[bg, 3] = 0
+    cut[..., :3] = orig
+    return cut
+
+
+def poly_mask(shape, pts) -> np.ndarray:
+    m = np.zeros(shape[:2], np.uint8)
+    cv2.fillPoly(m, [np.array(pts, np.int32)], 1)
+    return m.astype(bool)
+
+
+def save(rgba, mask, name, meta) -> None:
+    ys, xs = np.nonzero(mask & (rgba[..., 3] > 0))
+    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xs.min() - PAD, ys.min() - PAD, xs.max() + PAD + 1, ys.max() + PAD + 1
+    part = np.zeros((y1 - y0, x1 - x0, 4), np.uint8)
+    sx0, sy0 = max(x0, 0), max(y0, 0)
+    sx1, sy1 = min(x1, rgba.shape[1]), min(y1, rgba.shape[0])
+    src = rgba[sy0:sy1, sx0:sx1].copy()
+    src[~mask[sy0:sy1, sx0:sx1]] = 0
+    part[sy0 - y0:sy1 - y0, sx0 - x0:sx1 - x0] = src
+    Image.fromarray(part, "RGBA").save(os.path.join(OUT, "monster_cetus_%s.png" % name))
+    meta["parts"][name] = [int(x0), int(y0)]
+    print(name, part.shape[1], "x", part.shape[0])
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    top = cutout(os.path.join(ART, "cetus_top.png"))
+    solid = top[..., 3] > 0
+    meta = {"parts": {}, "mouth": MOUTH, "eyes": EYES, "hub": HUB, "head_x": HEAD_X, "size": [top.shape[1], top.shape[0]]}
+    body = solid.copy()
+    regions = {}
+    for name, part in PARTS.items():
+        regions[name] = poly_mask(top.shape, part["region"]) & solid
+        body &= ~regions[name]
+    near = cv2.distanceTransform((~body).astype(np.uint8), cv2.DIST_L2, 5) <= OVERLAP
+    for name, region in regions.items():
+        save(top, region, name, meta)
+        meta[name + "_pivot"] = list(PARTS[name]["pivot"])
+        body |= region & near
+    save(top, body, "body", meta)
+    side = cutout(os.path.join(ART, "cetus_side.png"))
+    save(side, side[..., 3] > 0, "side", meta)
+    meta["side_size"] = [side.shape[1], side.shape[0]]
+    with open(os.path.join(OUT, "monster_cetus.json"), "w") as f:
+        json.dump(meta, f, indent=1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+

+    orig = np.array(Image.open(path).convert("RGB"))
+    d = np.sqrt(((orig.astype(int) - BG) ** 2).sum(axis=2))
+    n, labels, stats, _ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats((d < BG_EDGE).astype(np.uint8), connectivity=4)
+    edge = set(labels[0, :]) | set(labels[-1, :]) | set(labels[:, 0]) | set(labels[:, -1])
+    bg = np.isin(labels, [i for i in edge if i != 0])

+    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xs.min() - PAD, ys.min() - PAD, xs.max() + PAD + 1, ys.max() + PAD + 1

+    part[sy0 - y0:sy1 - y0, sx0 - x0:sx1 - x0] = art[sy0:sy1, sx0:sx1]
+    Image.fromarray(part, "RGBA").save(os.path.join(OUT, "monster_charybdis.png"))

+    print("charybdis", part.shape[1], "x", part.shape[0])
